highResTransform.description: No resize/cache path used; full-res images served directly. Lightbox opens .fotorama__img--full at native resolution (up to 1875x2500). The full-res src is identical path to the regular img — no transform needed. Zoom in/out is CSS-only within the fotorama lightbox.

notes: Magento 2 with Synolia/lisecharmel theme. Color variants are separate product URLs (full page reload on color click — each color is a distinct configurable product). Size is a Magento swatch attribute (data-attribute-code='taille'); clicking opens a slide-in modal panel, selection closes it and updates the button label with no page reload. Gallery is Fotorama-based with dot nav (.fotorama__nav__frame--dot) and prev/next arrows (.fotorama__arr--prev / .fotorama__arr--next); clicking dots/arrows updates main image in-place with   no reload. Clicking the main image opens a fullscreen Fotorama lightbox; lightbox prev/next use the same .fotorama__arr selectors; zoom in = .fotorama__zoom-in, zoom out = .fotorama__zoom-out, close = .fotorama__fullscreen-icon (or Escape key). Lazy loading uses img[data-src] with a base64 GIF placeholder; 95–111 lazy images observed per product page. No bot protection (Cloudflare, reCAPTCHA, DataDome, etc.) detected. Cookies include Mage session/cache cookies, Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, and Hotjar.
